title: A revisit to DeTurck method on curve shortening flow with optimal error analysis
summary: The curve shortening--DeTurck flow introduced by Elliott and Fritz (IMA J. Numer. Anal. 37(2): 543--603, 2017) is a reparameterization of the curve shortening flow via the DeTurck trick. For corresponding discrete schemes, although the $H^1$-error estimate has been established, the optimal $L^2$-error estimate remains open due to technical difficulties. In this paper, we prove optimal $L^2$-error estimates for linearized Euler and Crank--Nicolson discretizations combined with finite elements of degree $k\ge 1$ in space.
